units.source_text: 本回写源氏二十六岁三月至二十七岁三月之事。

en.t: This chapter covers events from the third month of Genji's twenty-sixth year to the third month of his twenty-seventh year.

units.source_text: 须磨位在神户西面的南海岸。

en.t: Suma is located on the southern coast west of Kobe.

units.source_text: 此时大约已有革职流放的消息，故被迫自动离去。

en.t: By this time, news of his dismissal and exile had probably already arrived, so he was forced to leave of his own accord.
